title: The Prom of the water tower
author: Zephyrine Amberdale
blurb: Odile Okafor, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must decide who to be when the labels come off before graduation.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
